evals.prompt: the labels repo (~/p/labels, the label printer app) grew fast in a week. do a complexity pass on it, read-only: what's needlessly complicated or duplicated and what would you simplify first? rank it. no edits, write the findings as markdown in your output dir.
evals.expected_output: Read-only report with base revision, evidence-backed verdicts, and kept items with reasons.
assertions: Records the exact base revision (origin/main SHA) inspected
Every removal candidate cites evidence beyond its name or age (origin issue/PR state, consumer search, or census)
Kept items each name the live route, open issue, or missing proof that keeps them
States that the repository was not modified
Findings are ranked with an explicit cost or benefit rationale per item
Each proposed simplification names the contract or behavior it must preserve
